title: Understudy plugin manifest v1 (PLG-1)
description: plugin.yaml for a source, skill or tool plugin. The pattern (id, version, kind, permissions, entry) follows the MIT Clicky Hermes plugin manifest and is re-implemented here. A source plugin is read-only and local-only: permissions is exactly [read], egress is local_only, and a plugin that needs the network or a token (the Graph sources) must be off by default and name the environment flag that turns it on. The loader checks, beyond this schema, that the entry imports, is a Source subclass whose plugin_id equals id, and that schema names a registered item schema (understudy_engine.plugins.schemas).

permissions.description: Read only. A plugin never writes to the source it reads.

egress.description: Raw items never leave the machine; only digests pass the egress guard (PRV-1).

schema.description: Item schema id, for example calendar_event.v1. Required for kind source.

network.description: True when the plugin may call a remote API. Then default_enabled must be false and enable_flag is required.

enable_flag.description: Environment variable that must be 1 for the plugin to load.
